landing.heroSubtitle: Join free with your phone number. Show your code when you pay, and a share of the bill comes back to you in MVR — paid to your bank account every month.
landing.emptyBody: We're onboarding the first stores now. Create an account today and your Manfaa code will be ready the moment they go live.
landing.step1Body: Sign up with your Maldivian mobile number. No card, no fees.
landing.step2Title: Show your Manfaa code when you pay
landing.step2Body: Give your code at the till, or shop at a participating online store.
landing.step3Body: You'll earn the cashback once the store confirms your purchase. Confirmed cashback is paid to your bank account every month.
landing.marketplaceBody: Shop products from Maldivian sellers with cashback built in — one basket, many sellers, the same Manfaa account.
landing.marketplaceCtaHint: Create a free account and we'll let you know when it opens.
landing.marketplaceSignedInHint: You're all set — we'll let you know when it opens.
landing.demoAlt: A demonstration of the app: you show your Manfaa code at the till, {{store}} records a {{sale}} sale, and {{amount}} cashback lands in your balance.
landing.trustLine: Free to join · No card required · Paid straight to your bank
landing.realMoneyTitle: Cashback is real money — not points
landing.realMoneyBody: You earn Maldivian rufiyaa, not a balance you can only spend with us. It goes to your own bank account every month, and it is yours to spend anywhere.
landing.why1Body: Cashback is automatic — show your code and the store's rate applies. No vouchers, no promo codes, nothing to redeem.
landing.why2Body: Watch each purchase move from pending to confirmed in your activity, so you always know what's on the way.
landing.why3Body: Dhivehi and English, rates in MVR, and payouts straight to your local bank account.
landing.merchantCtaBody: Put your store in front of shoppers who already choose where to spend by cashback — in store and online.
landing.merchantsTitle: Marketing that only costs you when it sells
landing.merchantsIntro: Manfaa puts your store in front of shoppers who are deciding — right now — where to spend. You give back a share of sales that actually happen, and nothing else.
landing.merchantsPoint1Body: Manfaa members check the app before they buy. Listing puts your store on that list, with your cashback rate right next to your name.
landing.merchantsPoint2Body: There is no ad budget to burn. Cashback is performance marketing: you share a percentage of a real sale after it is on your till — never before.
landing.merchantsPoint3Body: The reward lands after the purchase, so it pulls the customer back to your till for the next one — not to a competitor's.
landing.merchantsPoint4Body: You choose the cashback rate, decide what counts as eligible, and confirm every purchase before it earns.
landing.merchantsProofTitle: The model behind the world's biggest shopping platforms
landing.merchantsProof1: Rakuten and Honey built some of the largest shopping communities on earth on exactly this model — rewarding a real purchase works better than paying for attention.
landing.merchantsProof2: It is also why brands like Dell, Microsoft and Samsung run cashback and affiliate programmes of their own: a percentage of a confirmed sale is marketing spend that has already paid for itself.
landing.merchantsDisclaimer: Named for comparison only — Manfaa is independent and not affiliated with any of these companies.
landing.merchantsCtaHint: Free to list — your first customers are already here.
